summary: The trace shows successful completion of a training feedback HWPX template filling task. The agent applied three key transformations not covered by the existing skill: (1) stripping unit suffixes like '명' from numeric values, (2) reformatting ratio scores like '4.5/5.0' to Korean-style '4.5점 (5.0점 만점)', and (3) appending additional text to existing field values. The existing hwpx-editing skill covers basic placeholder replacement but lacks guidance on value transformation patterns common in Korean document workflows. The skill should be extended with a 'Value Transformation Patterns' section covering these reusable patterns.
